schema_version.description: Must be 1; anything else triggers migration (SPEC §11.7.1).

system_prompt_extra.description: Appended to the system prompt, `≤ 4000` chars.

providers.description: Per-provider settings keyed by provider id (SPEC §4.5).

models.description: Per-model overrides keyed by registry id (REQ-PROV-014).

models_path.description: Path to a custom `models.json` ("" = bundled registry).

Mode.description: The four operating modes (SPEC §7.1). Serialized as `plan`, `build`, `auto`, `auto-unsafe`.

allow_protected_paths.description: Glob patterns that opt paths out of the protected-path set (SPEC §9.4).

verify_untrusted_html.description: Adds an untrusted-content warning header to `web_fetch` output.

allow_hosts.description: Hosts or `*.suffix`; empty = any host (subject to rules).

shareable.description: Write plans to a shareable file (SPEC §7.3).

auto_approve.description: Auto-approve produced plans in headless runs (REQ-MODE-007).

inherit_unsafe.description: Subagents never inherit `auto-unsafe` unless this is true (SPEC §8.8).

format.description: `tui` is only usable on a TTY.

input_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema for the tool input.

x-cli-flags.default: text if not TTY, else tui

x-cli-flags.description: no network; provider calls fail fast
